To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Levenshteintype bounds are valid for a much larger class of potential functions than previously known, and that they can be extended to the case of designs in Hamming space.

(i) the bounds on the energy hold for any potential function, not necessarily symmetric, and for a wide class of codes and designs, and (ii) they can be used to obtain the exact energy of a code and of a design, and to obtain bounds on the energy for other designs and codes.
the Levenshteins bounds for maximal codes in the Hamming space are universal bounds for the energy of codes in Hamming spaces, and for the energy of designs in Hamming Spaces.

the bounds presented in this paper are universal, unified, general, and optimal.

we have obtained a general theory of energy bounds for codes and for designs.
we provide a general method to bound the energy of codes, designs, and their duals.

the energy of codes in Hamming spaces is tightly bounded by the energy of designs in Hamming space.
